examples.text:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Mina
    participant UI as Browser
    participant API as Repair API
    Mina->>UI: Submit the booking form
    UI->>API: POST /repairs
    API->>API: Check postcode
    create participant Quote as Quote renderer
    API->>Quote: Render quote for R17
    destroy Quote
    Quote-->>API: quote.pdf
    API-->>UI: 201 Created: R17
    Note right of API: The renderer exists only for this request

sequenceDiagram
    participant UI as Browser
    participant API as Repair API
    loop up to 30 times
        UI->>API: GET /repairs/R17
        API-->>UI: 200: status
        break status is scheduled
            Note over UI: Show the appointment
        end
        Note over UI: Wait 2 s
    end

sequenceDiagram
    participant DB as Repair DB
    participant Worker as Notification worker
    participant Provider as Email provider
    Note over DB,Worker: ref: Mina books a repair (writes job J9)
    Worker->>DB: Claim a job for 5 min
    DB-->>Worker: Job J9
    Worker->>Provider: POST /emails
    Provider-->>Worker: 202 Accepted

SELECT order_id, placed_at, total
FROM index_orders
WHERE customer_id = 42
  AND placed_at >= timestamptz '2026-02-01 00:00:00+00'
ORDER BY placed_at DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT order_id, placed_at, total
FROM index_orders
WHERE customer_id = 42
  AND placed_at >= timestamptz '2026-02-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND status = 'paid'
ORDER BY placed_at DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 10;

CREATE INDEX index_orders_day
ON index_orders (((placed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date));

EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
SELECT order_id, placed_at, total
FROM index_orders
WHERE customer_id = 42
  AND placed_at >= timestamptz '2026-02-01 00:00:00+00'
ORDER BY placed_at DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 10;

Limit (actual rows=10.00 loops=1)
  Buffers: local hit=4
  ->  Index Only Scan using index_orders_cover on index_orders
        (actual rows=10.00 loops=1)
        Index Cond: ((customer_id = 42) AND
          (placed_at >= '2026-02-01 00:00:00+00'))
        Heap Fetches: 0
        Buffers: local hit=4
